name: Marriage Incentive Reward Scheme
benefit: In the case of the young man with the disability: Rs. 15,000/- is provided. In the case of the girl with the disability Rs. 20,000/- is provided. In case of disability of both young man and girl Rs. 35,000/- is provided.
eligibility_rules: Certificate of minimum 40% disability. The couple should be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh or its domicile for at least five years. None of the members of the couple has been convicted in any criminal case. The age of the girl child in the couple should not be less than 18 years and not more than 45 years at the time of marriage. The age of the man should not be less than 21 years and not more than 45 years at the time of marriageNo one from the couple is an income taxpayer. The marriage has been registered.
documents_required: Proof. Address Proof. Photograph. Disability percent proof. Marriage certificate.
how_to_apply: Mode: Online First, the applicants have to visit the official portal. Now, click on the registration. Fill out the application form. i. Type and percentage of disability of the couple.ii. Couple Name.iii. Present Address of the Couple.iv. Marriage Registration Certificate. Submit the application form. Note: The desired information has to be given on all the points mentioned in the application form. It is mandatory to submit a hard copy of the online application form to the District Disabled Empowerment Office of your district within 15 days).
